children: DOWNERS GROVE, Ill., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
, part of

and a leading provider of pharmaceutical serialization and traceability solutions, today announced the launch of Systech TraceIQ™, an intelligent and intuitive enterprise traceability platform created for a new operational reality in pharmaceutical supply chains.

Backed by Systech's four decades of packaging execution and serialization expertise, TraceIQ combines core compliance capabilities with an operational intelligence layer enhanced by AI-assisted analytics designed for today's pharmaceutical supply chains.

User-friendly and fast to deploy, TraceIQ transforms traceability data from a passive record of transactions into an active source of insight, enabling teams to identify patterns, investigate root causes and collaborate more effectively with partners.

"Serialization created unprecedented visibility into pharmaceutical supply chains, but visibility alone does not solve operational issues," said Sreedhar Patnala, General Manager, Systech. "Organizations need to quickly understand what happened, why it happened and what action to take next. TraceIQ helps teams move beyond compliance reporting to make proactive, informed decisions that keep products moving throughout the supply chain safely and in a timely manner."
Systech TraceIQ is built around three operational outcomes:
Prevent issues before they impact production:
Built-in validation and guardrails help identify bad data and avoidable errors before they create downstream exceptions, rework or shipment delays.
Resolve exceptions before they become disruptions:
Centralized traceability data and AI-assisted investigation help teams determine what happened, identify likely causes and take corrective action faster.
Turn traceability data into operational decisions:

Intuitive search, analytics and intelligent assistance provide supply chain, quality and compliance teams with the insights needed to make quicker decisions, improve partner collaboration and optimize performance.

From emerging biopharmaceutical companies preparing for commercial launch to global manufacturers and contract organizations managing complex partner ecosystems, TraceIQ helps organizations move beyond compliance and unlock greater value from their serialization and traceability investments through greater operational visibility and increased productivity.

Systech TraceIQ is in production with customers and is being showcased in live demonstrations at the Healthcare Distribution Alliance (HDA) Traceability Seminar in Washington, D.C., from August 31 to September 2, 2026. Learn more about TraceIQ here.
About Systech:

Systech is a trusted provider of pharmaceutical track and trace solutions, bringing more than 40 years of expertise from the packaging line to the broader supply chain. Built on deep line-level experience, its integrated hardware and proven software solutions help reduce operational friction, improve efficiency, strengthen compliance and protect product integrity. With a perspective shaped by the realities of packaging, serialization, inspection and traceability, Systech partners with manufacturers of all sizes to build connected, modern supply chains that drive productivity and operational excellence. Systech is a leading brand of Markem-Imaje and a part of Dover Corporation. Visit www.systechone.com for further information.
About Markem-Imaje:

Markem-Imaje, a wholly owned subsidiary of Dover Corporation, connects products and protects brands through intelligent identification, traceability and consumer engagement solutions. We offer the industry's most comprehensive range of marking and coding systems seamlessly integrated with trusted software, services and consumables. Over 50,000 customers worldwide partner with us to help them unlock the power of information in codes. With decades of proven expertise provided through the most extensive global network, we empower our customers to optimize supply chain efficiencies, achieve sustainability and compliance objectives, keep products safe and engage their consumers. This is intelligence, beyond the mark. Visit www.markem-imaje.com for further information.
About Dover:

Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $8 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments: Engineered Products, Clean Energy & Fueling, Imaging & Identification, Pumps & Process Solutions and Climate & Sustainability Technologies. Dover combines global scale with operational agility to lead the markets we serve. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 70 years, our team of approximately 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible. Headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois, Dover trades on the New York Stock Exchange under "DOV." Additional information is available at dovercorporation.com.
